_comment: Regions registry — single source of truth for plaz multi-region deployments.
Consumed by:
- .github/workflows/landing-zone.yml     (matrix discover)
- .github/workflows/deploy-workload.yml  (matrix discover)
- .github/workflows/comin-status.yml     (matrix discover)
Fields:
env         Selects infra/environments/<env>-{landing-zone,workload}.bicepparam.
Also passed to az deployment sub create as the deployment name suffix.
location    Azure region (lowercase, no spaces). Becomes the rg-...-<location> suffix.
gateway     Per-region gateway host name (gw1, gw2, gw3, ...). Becomes the NixOS
hostname and VM name suffix. Must also exist as nixos/hosts/<gateway>/.
regionCode  Short code used in resource naming (legacy; exported as env var only).
enabled     true = region is deployed by push/auto runs. false = region is skipped
entirely (no landing-zone, no workload, no comin-status). Manual
workflow_dispatch with environment=<env> still deploys a disabled
region (useful for one-off teardown/repair).
primary     Optional marker for the project's primary region (gallery + Key Vault).
To add a new region: append a new entry here, create the bicepparam files and the
nixos/hosts/<gateway>/ directory, register the host in nixos/flake.nix. That's it —
the workflows pick it up automatically.
To pause a region without deleting its config: flip its 'enabled' to false.
